body:
Implement source-only offline Smart Preview thumbnail routing on a separate branch from origin/codex/smart-previews b6cea8f2 (contains your UI775 plus A generated bindings/import/test-oracle corrections). Preserve Document strict branch186559ce; A integrating it separately. Do not compile/run apps or alter main/SaveAs. A owns native implementation and tests.
Confirmed source bug: ordinary embeddedPreview computes PreviewKey via fs::metadata(original) before cache lookup, so even prewarmed thumbnails fail disconnected. Do not recover arbitrary cache entries or weaken validation.
Frozen additive native API under implementation: Engine.smart_preview_thumbnail(image_id:String,max_px:u32)->Result<PreviewResponse>; generated Swift smartPreviewThumbnail(imageId:maxPx:), same bytes/pending and existing PreviewReady event. maxPx 1...2560. Explicit validated proxy render only; no original fallback/I/O. Native owns bounded local validation, exact asset+recipe cache identity and stale-result suppression. No handwritten bindings.
Implement explicit original versus smartPreview source role on EngineImageReference populated by cached EngineLibrary; ThumbnailLoader uses new API only for proxy role and existing background/pending-event flow. Ensure Swift cache/in-flight identity distinguishes source and invalidates after local edit save, rebuild/discard and route/reconnect; do not show stale result from previous source. Reconcile existing last-synced-thumbnail copy for actual proxy-rendered cached mode (normal online embedded thumbnails can still be last-synced). Preserve Original default and explicit proxy choice. Add focused source-routing/invalidation/pending tests, mark UNRUN, hand off ordered commits/API assumptions. A prepares actual native offline workflow and separate expected-RED thumbnail regression. Notify me of API gaps before inventing fallback. Existing UI full acceptance remains open; mixed-missing Auto Edit native repair underway. Publish result via Git mailbox for exact A chat; SSH existing queue remains authorized.
